rv.q: His is a naturally noble and gracious Othello, grave, dignified and touching in his devotion to Desdemona, so when he is driven to murder her—the killing is staged with chilling realism—the shock of it has a searing force.
For its latest annual summertime offering of performances free to the public, Classical Theatre of Harlem delivers a solid open-air revival of Othello at the Amphitheatre in Marcus Garvey Park.

cn.t: Classical Theatre of Harlem delivers a solid outdoor revival of Shakespeare's tragedy, with critics praising its accessible staging and strong performances despite the open-air challenges.
